{{translated title}} '''Anipoke Selection''' (Japanese: '''アニポケセレクション''' ''Anime "Pocket Monsters" Selection'') was a series of reruns of 57 select episodes from past [[series]] of {{aniseries|PTS}} on [[The Pokémon Company]]'s official Japanese [[YouTube]] channel.
